A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same FRIEDA benchmark. The main text, figures, tables and Appendices A–H support reliable comparison; appendix content is unchanged apart from running headers.

before.justification: v1 reports original evaluations of 11 LVLMs, human performance, reasoning ablations, error analyses and model-size experiments on FRIEDA.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical evaluations and analyses, including the main results and detailed appendix results.

M1.justification: The benchmark construction, direct/contextual inputs and answer-scoring procedures are retained. The added description of GPT-based searchability screening documents the existing filtering step rather than establishing a changed method.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same 500-question benchmark, covering 32 countries, six domains and six spatial relations, with single-map, multi-map, direct and contextual settings. No coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: The same three proprietary and eight open-source LVLMs and human comparison are retained. The Ovis2.5 reasoning variants and InternVL3.5 size variants evaluated in supplementary experiments are also unchanged.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and the appendices retain the inference controls, annotator-agreement subsets, textual judging, 20% distance-error tolerance and adjacent-direction acceptance rule. The added curation explanation does not establish a revised experimental protocol.

E4.justification: The Ovis2.5 reasoning ablation, Gemini error analysis, direct/contextual comparison, category breakdowns, InternVL3.5 size study and error examples are unchanged in Section 5 and Appendices E–F.

E5.justification: Appendix E.2 retains the same McNemar tests, exact-binomial versus corrected chi-square selection rule, and Table 7 significance reporting. No repeated-run, seed or uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Matched numerical and qualitative results are unchanged throughout. Table 2 retains direct accuracies of 38.20% for Gemini-2.5-Pro, 37.20% for GPT-5-Think and 84.87% for humans; the ablation and appendix results also match.

T1.justification: The spatial-relation definitions and taxonomy in Section 2 and Appendix B.2 are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, theorems or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The benchmark contribution and central claim of a substantial human–LVLM gap in multi-step cartographic reasoning remain unchanged. The expanded conclusion summarizes existing findings; updated resource-release wording does not introduce a new scientific contribution.

C2.justification: The expanded conclusion restates failures in symbol interpretation, cross-map integration and spatial semantics already discussed in v1. Interpretations concerning retrieval, reasoning and model size, and the geographic, language and domain limitations, remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v1 promises a future resource release; v2 adds dataset and code links and reports released prompts, configurations, annotation-interface code and test results. Section 3.2 also identifies GPT with web search as the searchability-screening tool. These improve access information and documentation while the detailed appendix instructions remain unchanged; external resource contents are not verified by the PDFs.

R1.justification: The cited works, Section 6, Appendix G and Table 17 retain the same research positioning against document, chart, map-VQA and spatial-reasoning work. No cited work or substantive novelty comparison is added or removed.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized wording corrections, clarifies construction prose, expands the conclusion and rewrites the reproducibility statement. It also adds acknowledgements, updates an affiliation and changes the running header to ICLR 2026 publication status. The section and appendix organization is retained.

P2.justification: Table 2 moves from page 7 to 8 and Table 3 from page 8 to 9. Figure 4 is enlarged and its caption changes the model-list order; resource links and icons alter the title-page layout. Scientific display contents remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: Compared with v1's future-release promise, v2 supplies concrete dataset, code and results access information and clarifies question screening, improving reproducibility documentation and usability. Editing and the expanded conclusion offer limited clarity gains. The empirical evidence, analyses and central scientific conclusions remain unchanged.
